description: Angular component for font settings panel in a widget configuration, including form controls, preview updates, and event handling.

classes.name: FontSettingsPanelComponent
classes.description: Angular component for configuring font settings with live preview and form controls.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes form controls, sets up value change subscriptions, and filters font list.

methods.name: clearFamily
methods.description: Clears the font family selection and refocuses input.

methods.name: clearDisabled
methods.description: Checks if font settings are partially set.

methods.name: clearFont
methods.description: Resets the font form to default values.

methods.name: updatePreviewStyle
methods.description: Updates the style preview based on current font settings.
